response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong track record in testing culture, open-source tooling, and performance-sensitive systems, but his profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The position demands deep Java and Kotlin expertise plus solid Spring/enterprise-framework experience, while his last decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web/full-stack work. Java appears only peripherally (robotic arms, device orchestration at Altom, listed last in skills), Kotlin and Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate are absent entirely, and there is no evidence of JVM internals or build-tool/application-server work. The one relevant signal is IDE development experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI) and a genuine interest in developer tooling, but that alone does not offset the missing JVM ecosystem foundation for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise-framework subsystems.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI) and ongoing developer-tooling work
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, test frameworks, open-source library authorship
Long track record across complex systems, including low-latency high-throughput services
concerns: No Kotlin and no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience anywhere in the resume
Java use is minimal and dated; no evidence of deep JVM understanding
Recent 8+ years are TypeScript/Node/DLang web work, not enterprise JVM tooling
